findings.title: Return failure when candidate acceptance gates fail
findings.why_it_matters: The documented verification command exits successfully even when an envelope, allocator, finite-bound or lifecycle acceptance check returns false. These checks generally collect booleans instead of raising assertions, and main only writes and prints the aggregate result; a shell script that uses the command's status can therefore accept a regressed core. Preserve the diagnostic receipt, then return a nonzero status on scoped_acceptance_pass=false, matching the compact-profile verifier.
findings.suggested_fix: After writing and printing RESULT.json, add `if not result['scoped_acceptance_pass']: raise SystemExit(1)`. Add a focused harness-level check that stubs one acceptance component to false and verifies a failing process status while the failing receipt is still written; also check that an all-pass result exits zero.
evidence: experiments/sound-hardware-v1/candidate_review/verify_candidate.py:261 computes scoped_acceptance_pass from reported gate booleans; line 262 writes the receipt, and line 265 invokes main without inspecting or returning the aggregate result.
experiments/sound-hardware-v1/candidate_review/verify_compact_profile.py:163-164 explicitly raises SystemExit(1) when scoped_equivalence_pass is false, providing an existing parallel implementation.

experiments/sound-hardware-v1/candidate_review/frozen_01/RESULT.json retains scoped_acceptance_pass=false for a real oldest-held allocation regression, demonstrating that a false reported gate is a supported and consequential outcome rather than an unreachable scenario.

Checked current verifier SHA-256 0de3cf78e9d8ccb34373f9a3f817514e0002a53f16110b8e3ad828d9ff71b594, matching the frozen_03 RESULT harness digest. testing_gaps: The live parameter-update policy documented at hardware_candidate/README.md:57 lacks a direct semantic regression check: changing amp/filter sustain during sustain must update immediately, changing a running timed segment must retain its cached endpoint/rate, and the next segment must use the new settings. test_core.c fuzzes updates for finiteness and the compact tests compare profiles to the same baseline, but neither independently asserts these promised trajectories. A short public-API timeline can cover these policy branches without another long-duration run.
